subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 09/11] mountd: drop a deferred fsid lookup once it has been answered

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service in the NFS-utils package to remove a deferred file system ID (fsid) lookup once it has been answered. The patch addresses an issue where an entry that resolves for the second time is still processed by nl_retry_expkey(), resulting in duplicate answers. To fix this, the patch introduces two new functions: delayed_expkey_matches() and delayed_expkey_remove(). The first function checks if a deferred fsid lookup matches a given request, while the second function removes any matching deferred lookup from the queue. The patch also updates the nl_expkey_singly() function to remove answered entries from the retry queue.
